prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: seamless square PBR base-color texture for cast-iron window frames in a historic Hamburg dock warehouse, representing a 32 by 32 centimeter patch of painted metal. Primary request: a photorealistic flat orthographic material scan of aged neutral warm-grey enamel over cast iron. Fine brush texture, thin subtly uneven paint, pinhead pits, sparse small worn chips exposing dark charcoal iron and tiny umber oxide edges, localized faint soot and accumulated grime. More than 95 percent intact grey paint. Delicate realistic wear, not distressed decoration. No planks, seams, screws, cracks, labels, shapes, borders, text, or objects. Uniform diffuse cross-polarized lighting, no cast shadows, no highlights or vignette, no directional illumination baked in. Edge-to-edge material only, seamless on both axes, high detail with natural multiscale variation. Keep the paint mid grey so the game can tint it green or cream.
usage: Existing Lowtide window-frame materials; source albedo retained, technical normal and roughness maps derived.
